reason: Both are asset-based North American freight carriers selling per-shipment transportation to B2B shippers. Their core lines differ. J.B. Hunt is mainly intermodal, dedicated contract trucking and truckload brokerage, with some LTL and final-mile. XPO's saved-site evidence shows it focused on LTL. The overlap is partial on product and strong on customers, so it is adjacent rather than direct.
missing_evidence: The XPO evidence shown does not cover its brokerage or last-mile lines, which are the likeliest overlap with J.B. Hunt. The size of J.B. Hunt's own LTL line is also unclear.
